newsitem.title: USA: New Brunswick 630 MW nuclear plant at full output.
newsitem.headline: New Brunswick 630 MW nuclear plant at full output.

text.p: New Brunswick Power Co said Monday its 630 megawatt (MW) nuclear power station resumed full output after tripping off line Nov 15 during maintenance on its control computers.
"The Point Lepreau generating staion returned to service Sunday and was generating at near full power by yesterday afternoon," the utility said in a statement.

The Lepreau facility has two control computers which allow for back-up and maintenance. As technicians were returning control to the lead computer following maintenance work, a component failed, and the plant shut automatically.
The Lepreau nuclear station is 45 kilometres south of the city of St John.
Headquartered in Fredericton, New Brunswick Power has a total installed capacity of 4,000 MW.
